A higher backtest return doesn’t automatically mean a better strategy.

A proper evaluation engine checks:
→ Returns after transaction costs
→ Maximum drawdown and risk
→ Out-of-sample performance
→ Stability across market regimes
→ Overfitting from testing too many variations

The goal isn’t to find the best-looking backtest. It’s to find a strategy that survives rigorous testing on unseen data.

This is how we move from AI-generated trading ideas to a structured, evidence-based research system.
